amendment.boundary: One-seed fixed-grid descriptive prediction/association, not significance, mediation, causal explanation or useful embedding dimensions. Original approximate features retain their measured limitations; exact sensitivity remains separate work.

numerical_policy.association: Exact rational baseline residuals and average-rank ties; zero residual or numerically unresolved nonzero feature/outcome direction has undefined association
numerical_policy.boundary: Numerical resolution is a declared input-stability convention, not statistical significance or causal identification; tiny exact improvements remain tiny
numerical_policy.display: 80-digit Decimal square roots and cancellation-safe RMSE subtraction converted to finite floats; display precision never decides improvement
numerical_policy.inputs: Every finite binary64 bridge value is its exact rational value; no decimal rounding or denominator approximation
numerical_policy.ols: Exact rational eight-column baseline and one-feature Frisch-Waugh-Lovell decomposition; no regularization
numerical_policy.redundancy: Exactly zero training residual yields baseline-equivalent predictions only if that same relation extends to every held-out row; otherwise augmented prediction is unidentified
numerical_policy.resolution: Nonzero added direction must have full rank under eps64 * max(rows,9) * leading singular value on the training-standardized augmented design
numerical_policy.standardization: Training-only affine feature standardization is algebraically eliminated using the intercept; retain its exact mean/variance and display scale
numerical_policy.support: Compare exact rational MSE; strictly lower pooled MSE and strictly lower in at least three of four folds; identical mathematical RMSE ordering
numerical_policy.undefined: Any unidentified/unresolved fold makes the full pooled augmented comparison and usefulness flag undefined; retain all rows and never pool only available folds

scientific_rules.adamw_overlap_rule: For Muon and NorMuon rows average overlap to all four AdamW rates. For an AdamW row average the other three AdamW rates, excluding self-comparison.
scientific_rules.association_table: Also report Pearson and Spearman associations after residualizing outcome and each feature on the locked baseline. These are descriptive and are not a substitute for held-out prediction.
scientific_rules.claim_boundary: This is one-seed, post-diagnosis mechanism triangulation. It can show whether geometry tracks or predicts retrieval variation beyond the locked baseline in this grid; it cannot identify mediation, prove causality, or generalize beyond the pinned model/data/optimizer grids.
features: mean saved-segment subspace overlap to all AdamW rates at the same stage
mean cumulative subspace overlap to all AdamW rates at the same stage
scientific_rules.outcome: mean decontaminated BEIR nDCG@10 over the 14 pinned tasks at the same checkpoint
scientific_rules.prediction_test: For each feature separately, compare a baseline containing optimizer indicators, stage indicators, and within-optimizer centered log10 learning rate with the same model plus the feature. Use four leave-dose-index-out folds, holding out the corresponding ordered learning-rate index for every optimizer and all stages.
scientific_rules.support_rule: Call a feature predictively useful only if adding it lowers pooled held-out RMSE and lowers RMSE in at least three of four folds. Report every feature and fold; do not select a feature for the paper based only on the pooled score.
